outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative pseudocoloured time-lapse images of a single photoactivation experiment per construct, with no quantification or statistics, so replicate reporting is not required.

replicate_statements: Insets represent average early time points responses measured in euchromatin and heterochromatin (red and green data sets, respectively) to emphasize on the initial plateau in heterochromatin.
Graphs representing normalized intensities measured during relaxation in the circled regions of the experiment displayed in (A)
outputs.explanation: The insets explicitly refer to 'average' early time-point responses, indicating data were pooled/averaged across some number of measurements, yet neither the legend nor the panel states how many replicates (n) were averaged or what kind of replicate (e.g., independent cells/experiments) they represent.
